article.title: smartclip在smartx加入AI素材審核建議，初期保留人員把關
article.summary: smartclip推出Creative Approval Agent，協助電視台及優質媒體的素材審核團隊按廣告語境評估內容。
highlights: 系統可建議批准、附投放限制批准，或拒絕素材。
初期推出採人員參與模式，支援青少年保護、競品限制及市場規則等審閱。
article.why: 廣告審核開始由辨認物件延伸至判斷情境，媒體團隊可先決定哪些限制需要人工確認才能套用。
article.next_step: 用酒類產品與非酒類產品的相似畫面檢查建議，逐項比較系統如何解釋情境和投放限制。
article.detail: smartclip以廣告中的瓶子為例，說明同一外觀可能是葡萄酒，也可能是醋；郵輪廣告中出現香檳，亦涉及產品和場景的區別。這類判斷會影響素材是否可在特定版位投放。媒體團隊可以把既有規則轉成一組有明確答案的案例，檢查建議理由是否足夠供審核人員覆查。
article.title_en: smartclip adds AI creative review recommendations with human oversight
article.summary_en: smartclip launched Creative Approval Agent to help broadcaster and premium publisher review teams assess ads in context.
highlights_en: It can recommend approval, approval with delivery restrictions or rejection.
Initial rollout keeps people involved and supports youth protection, competitor restrictions and market rules.
article.why_en: As review moves from object detection to context, media teams can decide which restrictions need a person's confirmation.
article.next_step_en: Compare similar alcohol and non-alcohol imagery and examine the reasoning behind proposed delivery restrictions.
article.detail_en: smartclip uses a wine bottle versus vinegar, and champagne in a cruise ad, to illustrate context. Those distinctions can affect placement eligibility. Teams can turn existing policies into cases with known decisions and check whether the agent's reasoning lets reviewers verify a recommendation.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
